description: Felling of a Cherry Tree (T6), subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/254/11/98, by cutting to ground level and grind stump 300mm below ground level; and pruning of various Trees (T1, T2, T4, and T9), subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/254/11/98, Cherry Tree (T1) by reducing crown by 2m, Crab Apple Tree (T2) by reducing crown height by 4m and reducing crown sides by 1.5m, Cherry Tree (T4) by reducing crown by 1.5m, and Norway Maple Tree (T9) by reducing crown by 2.5m.This tree had a Tree Preservation Order confirmed on 15 April 2025.
